name: ufo-roswell-case-closed.pdf
description: The Roswell Report: Case Closed by James McAndrew (U.S. Air Force, 1997), a front-matter-to-appendix document that refutes the Roswell "alien crash" and hospital-body claims by tying them to Project Mogul, high-altitude balloon anthropomorphic dummy drops (Project High Dive and Excelsior), and real Walker AFB accidents such as the 1956 KC-97 crash and 1959 balloon mishap.
